title: Insurance Claim Services Regulated-Scope Supplement: RRP Cleanup Lines
content:
**Rule.** In the regulated-scope supplement of Insurance Claim Services, the RRP cleanup is taken as follows: when the building was built before the water job tier's RRP year-built cutoff and the job is on a Black Water tier, the HEPA vacuuming billed on the job, because black-water containment is already part of the sewage protocol; when the building was built before that cutoff and the job is on any other tier, the containment setup and the HEPA vacuuming billed on the job; otherwise no cleanup line.

The year built and the tier are those recorded on the Water Damage Mitigation job; the lines are the containment setup and HEPA vacuuming lines billed on that job, at the amount billed. The RRP year-built cutoff is 1978 on every Water Damage Mitigation tier, so "built before the cutoff" means a year built of 1977 or earlier. The Black Water tiers are Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss and Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss.

## Decision table

| Year built (cutoff 1978) | Water job tier | Cleanup taken |
|---|---|---|
| 1977 or earlier | Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss or - Large Loss | the HEPA vacuuming billed |
| 1977 or earlier | any Clean Water or Gray Water tier | the containment setup and the HEPA vacuuming billed |
| 1978 or later | any tier | no cleanup line |

## Hypothetical cases

- A house built in 1962, Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss job, containment setup billed 355.50 and HEPA vacuuming billed 211.70: cleanup 567.20.
- The same lines on a Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss job built in 1962: cleanup 211.70, the HEPA vacuuming alone.
- The same lines on a building built in 1978: no cleanup line.
